description: This file defines a React component for a 'Delete Account' page, allowing users to confirm account deletion by entering their password, with options to export data or cancel the operation.

classes.name: DeleteAccount
classes.description: React component class for the delete account page, managing user input and deletion logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state and binds event handlers.

methods.name: onPasswordChanged
methods.description: Updates state with the new password and validation status when user types.

methods.name: isPasswordInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the current password input is invalid.

methods.name: onDeleteInvoked
methods.description: Handles the delete account action, calling API and redirecting on success.
